summary: Finished the workflows and other extension fixes directly (no subagents after the first two burned ~40% of the user's 5-hour usage), verified with the full test suite and build, then committed and pushed both the gizmo repo (branch pi-web, commit a9f6f41) and the gizmo-registry repo (main, commit 52746f0).
decisions: Never spawn subagents on the default (Fable) model; do work directly in the main session, and if a subagent is needed, pass an explicit haiku/sonnet model and ask before launching more than one.

Scope workflows and subagents panels to the open thread by passing a sessionId on the web extension context, filtering server-side runs by session and workspace, and clearing the list on thread switch.
Add a 5-second heartbeat and on-every-flush workflow.json write so the workflows tab shows live progress, and mark runs as aborted when their heartbeat is over a minute old.
Git Changes panel rows are keyed by kind+path and git paths are rebased to the workspace root so agent edits match in subdirectory workspaces.
Ask-user rejects duplicate option labels at the tool level and keys options by index.
Declarative views share a single shutdown hook per Pi instance instead of one per view.
PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR expands a leading ~ like Pi does.
errors: Bash heredoc patch script failed with 'unexpected EOF while looking for matching `'`' because of quoting; worked around by writing the Python patcher to a scratchpad file and invoking it directly.
